notes.title: Cosmic Cowboy - Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
We have fixed some game-breaking bugs that we were made aware of. Thank you to everyone who has played the demo so far!

Fixed end turn button being off-centre (Minor)

Fixed issue where players were being soft-locked and had to alt f-4 to hopefully not reencounter the bug. (Game breaking)

Fixed an issue with the skill screen where buttons were off the screen so players couldn't progress to the other skill menus and level 2. (Game breaking)

Fixed weapon clipping within the loading screen (Minor)

Numerous balance adjustments to gameplay.
